description.narrative: Project Y is about strengthening the capacity of youth to take on leadership to end teenage pregnancies in selected districts in Uganda. It will target youth-led (leader is below 30 years) grass roots organizations and empower them to manage their organizations progressively and sustainably. The project will involve training volunteers in selected youth-led grassroot organizations (community based - CBO) in organizational development, volunteerism, advocacy, gender, democracy, health and lifestyle and economic empowerment. The project will train, equip six (6) youth-led organizations that are part of the Youth Livelihoods Development Company (YLDC) youth structure to manage their activities sustainably so that they are able to reach out to other young people (villages and schools) with youth programs and activities so that these youngsters improve their capacity to make informed decisions about their wellbeing and end teenage pregnancies.
